subject: literature
passage: Every spring, Mateo and his cousins build kites out of bamboo strips and colored paper in their grandfather's courtyard. Every one of the kites that they make ______ a different name, usually chosen by the youngest cousin, and the names are painted along the tail in black ink.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The subject of the verb is "Every one," which is singular; "of the kites that they make" only describes which one. A singular subject needs the singular verb "gets."
explanation.A: Incorrect. "Are given" is plural, but the subject "Every one" is singular.
explanation.B: Incorrect. "Get" is plural and would agree with "kites," but the subject is the singular "Every one."
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Have" is plural, but the subject "Every one" is singular.
explanation.D: Correct. The singular verb "gets" agrees with the singular subject "Every one."
